desc:
Immerse yourself in autumn’s changing colours through en plein air sessions, drawing and painting directly in nature while learning landscape art techniques alongside a creative sisterhood.

Guided by Professional Artist Nora Alkeyat. Templates and materials provided.
18+ | Sisters only
Saturday Oct 10 & 17 (2-classes) | 12pm - 2pm
Meadowvale Community Centre, Program Room 2 | 6655 Glen Erin Dr, Mississauga
location: 6655 Glen Erin Dr, Mississauga, ON L5N 3L4, Canada
title: 🎨Autumn En Plein Air | Oil Pastel & Painting Course
